newsitem.title: FRANCE: BMW says 9-month sales up nine percent.
newsitem.headline: BMW says 9-month sales up nine percent.

text.p: German luxury carmaker BMW AG said on Tuesday that unit sales for the first nine months of 1996 were up nine percent at 868,000 units and that the sale of its brand name vehicles rose eight percent to 485,000 units.
BMW management board member Bernd Pischetsrieder said BMW's British-based Rover subsidiary reported a sales increase during the period from January to September of 10 percent to 383,000 vehicles.
The comments were made at a BMW news conference at the Paris car show.
